name: Creator layouts
brief: Load the creator-layouts skill and follow it. A creator's edit without a presenter: person footage in rounded cards under paper panels with one serif-italic accent word, a label box on the split seam, a coral arrow filling an empty slot, a real-number counter over a profile card, an S-to-F tier board where cards drop into rank. At least three of its layouts, one per scene, live one-phrase captions over footage.
